# ZYNIX Digital Agency

> ZYNIX is a premium international digital agency. We build websites that grow your business. We help small businesses in the UK, US and worldwide get more customers online.

Website: https://hadiya786-max.github.io/zynix-digital-agency/

## Services

- AI Calling Agents — AI phone receptionists that answer calls, take orders and book appointments for restaurants and local businesses, so no call (and no order) is ever missed
- WhatsApp Chatbots — automated WhatsApp replies, order taking and booking for businesses
- Monetized Accounts — ready TikTok and YouTube monetized accounts
- Websites — simple business websites, booking websites, e-commerce stores and premium 3D websites
- Video Ads — short video advertisements for products and local businesses
- Video Editing — professional editing for business and social media videos
- Social Media Management — content design and posting for business pages
- Monthly SEO — ongoing search optimisation so customers find the business on Google
